main_text.p: Atticé ὑμιόντων ὑμῶντων, pro ὑμαέτω- σαν ἀτωσαν, & in aliis similiter.
main_text.head: Futurum s. in μι.
main_text.p:
ἱςαϑι, ἱςάτω, statue, siste:
ἱςαζον, ἱςάτων:
ἱςατε, ἱςάτωσαν.
Etiam hic magis usurpantur à contractis personæ ἱςα, τίϑη, δίδου.
main_text.head: Cap. 10. De aoristo 1.
main_text.p: Atque hæc de temporibus infectis, præsenti, præterito & futuro: sequitur analogia perfectorum, præteriti ac futuri: præteriti, aoristi & horistici:
Bœoticé ἐτιμήσασαν, ut fit parisyllaba primæ plurali, ficut priús.

page.notes: The Greek forms are reproduced from a worn scan; accents and breathings in the verb forms are uncertain and may differ from the printed originals. The line "Cap. 10. De aoristo 1." is a heading set in italic. The final word "Sic" is set right-aligned at the foot of the text.
